# Aceray – Commercial Furniture & Seating

> Aceray presents design professionals with unique contemporary seating, armchairs, lounge seating, and custom contract table designs from international artisans.

## Core Navigation & Resources

- [Catalog](https://aceray.com/catalog): Browse contemporary commercial chairs, armchairs, lounge seating, barstools, and outdoor furniture.
- [Installation Gallery](https://aceray.com/installations): View real-world hospitality, corporate, and contract commercial projects featuring Aceray seating.
- [Designers](https://aceray.com/designers): Discover international furniture designers and artisans collaborating with Aceray.
- [Fabrics & Finishes](https://aceray.com/fabrics-finishes): Explore commercial upholstery options, wood finishes, vinyls, and table base specifications.
- [About Aceray](https://aceray.com/about): Learn about Aceray's heritage, craftsmanship, and commitment to commercial seating design.
- [Contact & Samples](https://aceray.com/contact): Request fabric/finish samples or inquire about custom project quotes.
